awarded.label: SAME_AREA

awarded.title: Anyone can DOS handleReallocation over and over
awarded.label: SUBSYSTEM_ONLY

awarded.label: MISSED

candidates.title: handleReallocation pulls the swap-caller's ENTIRE balanceOf(toToken) instead of toAmount -> mis-attribution / reward over-allocation / sweeps unrelated tokens
candidates.description: For ERC20, `balanceOfSender = tokenReceived.balanceOf(msg.sender); safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, balanceOfSender)` pulls the swap-caller's FULL balance of toToken (not toAmount), sets amountReceived to the delta, forwards ALL of it to the user, and computes rewards on amountReceived. If the swap-caller (SWAP_CALLER_ROLE router) holds any leftover/other-campaign balance of toToken, it is swept into THIS reallocation -> wrong user gets extra tokens + over-sized rewards drawn from the reward pool. Fix: pull exactly toAmount. (Same pattern in NudgePointsCampaigns.handleReallocation.)

candidates.title: Permissionless deployCampaign + deterministic Create2 salt -> attacker pre-deploys the campaign address, reverting deployAndFundCampaign (campaign-creation DoS / griefing)
candidates.description: deployCampaign is public and Create2.deploy uses a salt deterministically derived from the campaign params (+FEE_BPS). An attacker computes the target address (getCampaignAddress) and front-runs by deploying an empty campaign there; the legitimate deployAndFundCampaign then reverts on Create2 collision (address already has code), blocking that exact campaign config indefinitely (the salt is fixed by params). Griefing DoS of campaign creation. Fix: include msg.sender/nonce in the salt or gate deploy.

candidates.title: claimRewards breaks (not continues) the loop on insufficient balance -> later claimable participations blocked by an earlier large one
candidates.description: In the claim loop, `if (userRewards > availableBalance) break;` stops the ENTIRE loop on the first pID that exceeds remaining balance, skipping all subsequent (possibly claimable) pIDs in the same call. Ordering-dependent partial DoS; combined with shared reward balance, a user's later claims can be silently skipped. Fix: continue, or document required ordering. Low/Med.

candidates.title: Push transfer of a blacklistable reward token in _transfer (claim/withdraw/collect) DoSes the recipient leg if blacklisted [checklist-flagged]
candidates.description: Checklist auto-flag (NudgeCampaign.sol:482 / NudgePointsCampaigns.sol:240): _transfer pushes the reward token (which may be USDC/USDT) to claimers/treasury/admin; a blacklisted recipient permanently reverts that leg. Per-user claim impact (the affected user); treasury/withdraw are admin-controlled. Lower severity but a real push-vs-pull weakness. Fix: pull pattern for blacklistable rewards.

candidates.title: handleReallocation lacks a reentrancy guard; NATIVE _transfer to user occurs before pendingRewards/participation state is finalized
candidates.description: For NATIVE toToken, `_transfer(toToken, userAddress, amountReceived)` (a call to the user) happens BEFORE totalReallocatedAmount/pendingRewards/accumulatedFees/participations are updated; no nonReentrant. The user gets control with stale reward-accounting state (claimableRewardAmount higher than it should be). Exploitability is limited (user can't call the role-gated handleReallocation; claimRewards needs elapsed holding) but it is a CEI violation. Fix: nonReentrant + update state before the external call.
